column1: # Starter map from generator keys to a source id (manifest column 7), for
# scripts/group-manifest.py. A source id names the collection, camera or
# platform an item came from, for both classes, so that the items of one
# platform can be balanced, sliced and held out together.
# Tab-separated: generator glob, dataset glob, source id, basis, note.
# Matching ignores case; the first row that matches wins. An item that
# matches no row gets what `tintype split-groups` already assumes: the
# `real:<name>` key of a real item, the dataset of a generated one.
# This is a proposal for the maintainer to correct, not a record of fact.
